Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
I have two question on the Shadow Court Satyr.

I play a Shadow Court Satyr. I put a Burst of Sunlight on him. Do the Satyr suffer one damage when he use the card ?

Burst of Sunlight

[tha] Strike: 1R aggravated damage. This striking vampire also takes 1 aggravated damage.

I play a Shadow Court Satyr. I put an Absorb the Mind on him. Can I use either of the inferior level, I.E. both the dominate one (strike: dodge) and the Mysterceria one (strike: steal one blood) ? Can I use both in the same combat ? (on two separate round)

Absorb the Mind

[Combat] Combat
Mytherceria, Dominate
[dom] Strike: dodge.
[myt] Strike: ranged. Steal 1 blood.

Shadow Court Satyr (Changeling)

[Ally]
[Gangrel antitribu] Gangrel antitribu
[3 Pool]
Changeling with 3 life. 1 strength, 1 bleed.
When the Satyr enters play, you may put a combat card from your hand on him. Once each combat, the Satyr may use the ability of that card as if played from your hand. If the card requires a vampire (e.g., costs blood or requires a Discipline), he may use it as a vampire with the basic level of the Discipline (if any).

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: Yes he takes damage from Burst of Sunlight since he plays it 'as a vampire'. And yes he can use both versions of Absorb the Mind, but only once per combat total, not once per combat each.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
Thanks for the reply.

Bonus question : if a Shadow Court Satyr have an Hexe as the comabt card, the Satyr can play the Daimonion outferior (Strike: 2R damage.) but not the Striga inferior, because Striga is not a discipline. Am I right ?

Messages.Body:

Yes that is correct. Likewise SSC can't use any card that requires an anarch, his text only lets him get around the discpline requirement, not any other requirements.
